---
name: Compatibility or feature request
about: Propose a bounded generic runtime or compatibility capability
title: "[request] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What real compatibility gap or developer need does this address?

## Evidence / motivating software

What Android/AArch32 behavior, binary interface, or reproducible workload
requires it? Include public references, hashes, symbols, metadata, or generated
fixtures when possible.

## Proposed boundary

What is the smallest generic capability that would solve the problem without
adding application-specific behavior to the core?

## Validation idea

How could the behavior be regression-tested deterministically?

## Out of scope

What should explicitly remain deferred?
